svg.title: AIcoach, Faithful Merge: Other pages
svg.text: One idea per screen. Same thread, same voice, same evidence rules, with less on each page.
One form. Nothing else on the screen.

text.tspan: AI
coach

g.text: Sign in to see your swings.
Your swings are private to you.

svg.text: Email and password; deletion promised up front.

g.text: Email and password. Nothing else needed.

text.tspan: You can delete your account and every
swing from the Account page at any time.

svg.text: Six steps, one line each. Tap a step for detail.

g.text: 6 steps · about a minute to read

svg.text: One rule, one picture, one reason.

text.tspan: Put the phone on a stand or your bag,
behind your hands. Closer cuts off the
club; further makes your joints too
small to read.

svg.text: No guess. Each reason links to its guide step.

text.tspan: I won’t guess from this clip. Three
things got in the way:

g.text: I read only down the line, from behind.
I need the whole body to measure hips.
No result was made. Nothing was saved.

svg.text: A real answer, not an empty state. No drill.

text.tspan: None of my three rules fired. That’s a
real answer, so I won’t invent a drill.

g.text: Checked: early extension · loss of posture ·

text.tspan: Weight appears to move toward the
trail side at the top.

g.text: No drill: this is not in my rule table.

svg.text: The coach will not invent a drill it has no rule for.

text.tspan: Can you give me a drill for
the weight shift?
I can’t. The weight shift is unverified
and outside my rule table, so I have
no drill I can stand behind. A coach
can check it in person.
Based on: unverified observation
(confidence: low) · rule table

g.text: What did you check in my swing?
Answers are based only on this analysis.

svg.text: Date and main finding. Nothing more per row.

g.text: 5 saved swings · only you can see them

text.tspan: Removes every analysis, result, key frame
and saved clip.

svg.text: Plain consequences, then one clear choice.

text.tspan: This removes 9 analyses with their results
and key frames, and 5 saved swing clips.
It cannot be undone, and you will not be
able to sign in again.
